# Antimeridian Crossing LineString

A simple line crossing the 180° longitude line (antimeridian/dateline). Naive renderers will draw a line all the way around the globe instead of the short path across the Pacific.

    data = geocase_case.load()

## What this case checks

Expose code that naively interpolates across the Prime Meridian (0°) instead of correctly crossing the Antimeridian (±180°).

## Risk types covered

- `antimeridian_wrapping`
- `distance_calculation_error`
- `incorrect_rendering`
